review.assessment: The confirmed pre-match personnel information plus two synchronized snapshots 19 minutes apart satisfied the persistent-low-event gate. The later snapshot still showed only 0.20 combined xG, no shots on target, no big chances and two combined opposition-box touches. Whole-goal protection at exactly two goals improved robustness. The correct ex-ante model classification should have been OFFICIAL BET at 0.25u, provided the accepted price remained at least 1.70 and no material state change occurred before execution.
review.hindsightControl: The upgrade is based on correcting the information set available at recommendation time, specifically the previously omitted second snapshot, not on the 0-0 final score.
review.ledgerTreatment: Shadow-model review only. Do not add bankroll profit or describe the wager as placed without user confirmation.

modelRule: Two synchronized low-event snapshots separated by a meaningful interval, combined with confirmed personnel information and a protected whole-goal line, may qualify an early live under for official-bet review. Every score, line, price, card, substitution, injury or weather change still requires independent repricing.
